wizard.events.title: Event feedback
wizard.events.help: How should events be conveyed? Things like damage, healing, and spell effects happen in and out of combat, and the game's log reports the same things — so the wizard sets up one channel and quietens the other. Positional speech is the most immediate but needs SAPI; the others use your screen reader. You can fine-tune all of this later under Events and Log.
wizard.events.enemy_voice_help: Tune the voice for enemy events. Pick a voice distinct from your ally and main voices, so you can tell at a glance whether an event is an enemy's. Test it below.
wizard.events.ally_voice_help: Tune the voice for your party's (and neutral NPCs') events — a voice distinct from the enemy one. Test it below.
wizard.events.unitless_voice_help: Tune the voice for events with no source on the map — things like time passing or party-wide effects. These have no position, so they're always spoken non-positionally; give them a voice distinct from the enemy and ally voices so you can tell a sourceless event apart. Test it below.

desc.dh_porch.title: The South Landing
desc.dh_porch.body: A raised timber landing running along the tavern's south wall, a worn red carpet down its length and short steps dropping to the common room's flagstones. Candle pillars light the boards, and armed guards keep an eye on everyone who passes.
desc.dh_bedroom.title: A Guest Bedroom
desc.dh_bedroom.body: A small rented room off the west hall: two beds beneath leaded windows, a travelling trunk at the foot of one, and a round table set with a bottle and cups on a patterned rug. An iron candle ring hangs low over the boards, and a cat patrols the rug as if it owns the place.
desc.dh_parlour.title: The Parlour
desc.dh_parlour.body: A quiet sitting room tucked behind the bar: a cushioned couch, a low table holding a jug and a guttering candle, a patterned rug, and a painting on the wall. Somewhere to hear bad news sitting down.
desc.dh_common.title: The Common Room
desc.dh_common.body: The tavern's great stone-flagged taproom. A curved oak bar commands the northwest corner, backed by shelves of green bottles and kegs, stools drawn up along its front. A long communal table with benches stands at the centre on a worn rug, ringed by smaller round tables, and iron candle-ring chandeliers hang from the beams overhead. Since the city fell it is less a tavern than a stronghold's heart, crowded with crusaders and the newly homeless.
desc.dh_refugees.title: The Refugees' Quarters
desc.dh_refugees.body: The inn's westernmost rooms, given over to families burned out of their homes. Beds and cots stand close together beneath the windows, trunks and barrels crowd the corners, and survivors keep their voices low, as if the attack might hear them.
desc.dh_kitchen.title: The Kitchen
desc.dh_kitchen.body: A working kitchen built around a great stone hearth and chimney, its fire never quite allowed to die. Prep tables stand laden with river fish, ham and bread; strings of dried peppers hang by the door, striped runners soften the flagstones, and an iron grate in the floor breathes cool air from the cellar.
desc.dh_council.title: The War Room
desc.dh_council.body: A raised timber platform at the tavern's northeast corner, reached by a short stair flanked with folding screens. A long oval council table dominates it, strewn with maps and papers, high-backed chairs drawn around and a rich patterned carpet underfoot. From here Irabeth holds together what is left of Kenabres.
desc.dh_backstair.title: The Back Stair
desc.dh_backstair.body: A dim back hall behind the kitchen where a wooden staircase climbs to the upper floor. Barrels are stacked at its mouth, a shelf holds an old jug, and mice have the run of the boards.
desc.dh_refuge.title: The Refuge Corner
desc.dh_refuge.body: The common room's southeast corner, surrendered to the dispossessed. Bedrolls and sacking cover the flagstones in ragged rows; the wounded lie close together while neighbours tend them, and a cookpot and scattered bundles mark out each family's few feet of floor.
desc.dh_cellar.title: The Tavern Cellar
desc.dh_cellar.body: A torch-lit stone undercroft beneath the tavern, its flagstones strewn with splinters and straw. Great wine tuns rest on timber cradles against the north wall, with kegs, crates and stacked stores crowding the corners. In the northwest a stair climbs to the taproom, and a sloping passage in the northeast leads up to the street. Off-duty guards drink at a round table by candlelight beside a barred cell in the southwest, a wooden chest against the wall behind them, and iron levers jut from the walls among the barrels, part of some old mechanism.
desc.dh_cell.title: The Lockup
desc.dh_cell.body: A storeroom pressed into service as a jail: a floor-to-ceiling iron lattice walls it off from the cellar, its barred gate on the north side. Rotten straw and refuse are heaped over the flagstones, and the stores remain where they stood, fish barrels, a crate of goods and a dark cupboard, so the prisoner shares the room with the tavern's supplies. A few candle stubs on the floor give the only light.
desc.dh_shrine.title: The Hidden Shrine
desc.dh_shrine.body: A concealed chapel tucked behind the cellar's south wall, entered from the north. A worn red runner leads to a stone altar crowded with lit candles and skulls, crowned by an idol carved like a fanned comet-tail, a shrine to Pulura, goddess of the northern stars. Crimson banners flank a shield hung on the wall behind it, a tall bookcase packed with old volumes stands against the side wall, and a wash-table with a basin and jars waits near the entrance.
desc.dh_south_lane.title: The South Lane
desc.dh_south_lane.body: A dead-end cobbled lane squeezed between a ruined house, its balcony collapsed and windows boarded, and the spiked timber barricade of the crusader compound. Crates, sandbags and barrels are stacked along the fence line, an overturned handcart lies where it was abandoned, and dung and fallen leaves gather between the stones.
desc.dh_high_street.title: The Ruined High Street
desc.dh_high_street.body: A broad cobbled street with kerbed pavements, running past stone townhouses with shuttered and barred windows. One building's corner has collapsed into a mound of rubble and planks, signposts and lamp brackets stand bent, and smashed hoardings, stray cart wheels and crates litter the way.
desc.dh_barricade_gap.title: A Barricaded Gap
desc.dh_barricade_gap.body: A narrow fork of cobbles pinched off by the compound's palisade wall, beneath a corner shop with hanging signboards. Barricades seal it from the streets around; nothing passes through here now.
desc.dh_maple_corner.title: The Maple Corner
desc.dh_maple_corner.body: A street corner beneath a great maple blazing orange in a raised stone bed, its leaves drifted deep across the cobbles. Stone steps climb to a house door, bollards line the kerb, and kegs and crates wait against the walls under a lantern on a timber post.
desc.dh_west_crossroads.title: The West Crossroads
desc.dh_west_crossroads.body: A cobbled junction under a hanging street lantern, gutter channels curving through the stones. The houses around it stand torn open, roofs holed and rafters bare, while firewood, barrels and crates are hoarded along the outer face of the compound's palisade.
desc.dh_tavern_yard.title: The Tavern Yard
desc.dh_tavern_yard.body: The fortified yard before the tavern's door, ringed by sharpened stakes and burning braziers. The cobbles are churned to mud, an overturned cart and sacks serve as makeshift cover, and a stone altar of Abadar stands near the threshold, candles guttering on its steps.
desc.dh_camp.title: The Refugee Camp
desc.dh_camp.body: The great courtyard at the heart of the barricaded compound, given over to those the attack left homeless. Lean-to tents and bedrolls crowd the cobbles, cookpots hang over small fires, and wrecked carts, sacks and sharpened stakes are piled into barricades on every side. A timber watch-scaffold climbs overhead, and the mud is trodden black around the fire baskets.
desc.dh_east_gap.title: The East Gap
desc.dh_east_gap.body: A cramped pocket of cobbles against the eastern barricade, lit by a torch on the palisade post. Smashed chairs and crates lie where they were flung, and a fire basket burns down to embers beside the fence.
desc.dh_market_yard.title: The Market Yard
desc.dh_market_yard.body: The compound's northern yard, kept as a scrap of ordinary life: a produce stall stacked with pumpkins, fruit and baskets, hens pecking between the cobbles, and a handcart of crates by the wall. An arcaded stone warehouse closes off the north side, and a broad timber stair climbs from the yard to the rooftops above.
desc.dh_wrecked_yard.title: The Wrecked Yard
desc.dh_wrecked_yard.body: A yard strewn end to end with smashed furniture, chairs, tables and buckets flung across the cobbles. A maple in a raised bed has buried half the wreckage in orange leaves, a fire basket burns by the wall, and the house at its edge stands torn open, roof beams collapsed into the rooms below.
desc.dh_west_street.title: The West Street
desc.dh_west_street.body: A long street running along the compound's western palisade. A lamp on a leaning post lights a spill of rubble where a building's wall gave way, and bollards, barrels, straw and broken planks line the route between the houses.
desc.dh_north_gateyard.title: The North Gate Yard
desc.dh_north_gateyard.body: The courtyard inside the compound's torch-lit northern gate, where the road leaves for the rest of the city. A refugee tent stands against the fence amid crates and cushions, an autumn tree drops leaves over the cobbles, and wrecked handcarts wait where their owners left them.
desc.dh_east_street.title: The East Street
desc.dh_east_street.body: A devastated street along the palisade's eastern face, the cobbles churned with mud and strewn with smashed chairs and tables. Torches burn on the barricade posts, a lantern hangs from its hooked pole by a stone house's arched wagon-door, and rats pick through the refuse by the wall.
desc.dh_gate_close.title: The Gate Close
desc.dh_gate_close.body: A small walled close sealed behind the compound's barred side gate. An autumn tree stands over a stone outbuilding, straw bales and rope fences fill the corner, and torches on the gateposts light cobbles nobody crosses.
desc.dh_quiet_square.title: The Quiet Square
desc.dh_quiet_square.body: A cobbled square in the city's northeast corner that the attack largely spared. Kerbed paths curve around a stone house with a round gable window and arched door, a golden maple leans over its roof, and a woodpile sits stacked dry beneath a lean-to.
desc.dh_north_crossing.title: The North Crossing
desc.dh_north_crossing.body: A broad crossroads north of the compound, its lamp posts bent and lanterns dangling askew. A covered handcart lies wrecked on a broken wheel in the middle of the way, crates are scattered before a warehouse's iron-ringed arched gate, and a fire basket burns at the corner over mud-smeared cobbles.
desc.dh_lamplit_row.title: The Lamplit Row
desc.dh_lamplit_row.body: A long street of half-timbered townhouses whose windows still glow with lamplight, one of the few rows the city kept. The kerbed pavements are fouled with mud and dung, a lost cartwheel and an upturned basket lie among the leaves, and the wreck of a market canopy slumps at the far end.
desc.dh_gutted_close.title: The Gutted Close
desc.dh_gutted_close.body: A dead-end close beside a house gutted to its frame, the roof caved inward in a tangle of beams and rubble held back by a canvas screen. Across the way an intact stone house keeps its arched door and swept steps, next to a woodpile, a leaf-buried bench and a wrecked hay cart, with a lantern burning on its hooked post.
desc.dh_camp_catwalk.title: The Camp Catwalk
desc.dh_camp_catwalk.body: A timber stair and plank catwalk climbing from the yard by the tavern door up over the refugee camp. Crates and sacks are staged at the landings, and the boarded walk runs high across the rooftops, a lookout's roost above the tents and cookfires below.
desc.dh_west_roofs.title: The West Roof Deck
desc.dh_west_roofs.body: Flat-boarded rooftops on the compound's western side, reached by a zig-zag timber stair from the market yard. Benches stand out on the shingles among staged barrels, sacks and sandbags, and a broad planked ramp bridges from roof to roof, overlooking the street beyond the palisade.
desc.dh_roof_walk.title: The Rooftop Walk
desc.dh_roof_walk.body: A guarded plank walk running along the warehouse roofline above the market yard, laid boards spanning the gaps between roofs. Barrels, sacks and crates are cached along the ridge behind timber rails, and the walk looks out over the northern street beyond the wall.
desc.th_den.title: The Thieflings' Den
desc.th_den.body: A broad flagstone cellar under the hardware store, its brick walls braced with heavy timbers and lit by wall torches. Long trestle tables strewn with papers, maps and candle stubs fill the eastern side, barrels and a cold forge stand along the north wall by the entrance stair, and a sleeping alcove in the southwest corner holds a bed, a couch and a few stools. Bones and litter are trodden into the floor of the open middle.
desc.th_vault.title: The Common Fund Vault
desc.th_vault.body: Two cramped storerooms behind the lattice door on the den's east side, where the gang keeps its common fund. Shelving units crowd the walls, stacked with pots, bowls and oddments, crates sit in the corners, and a lattice-arched inner doorway joins the two chambers.
desc.shop_entry.title: The Shop Entrance
desc.shop_entry.body: A plank-panelled entry hall inside the shop's street door, dim and cold. An emptied bookcase stands against the wall, loose papers litter the boards, and the doorway ahead opens into the wrecked front room.
desc.shop_front.title: The Ransacked Front Room
desc.shop_front.body: A shop room torn apart in a violent search: a heavy display table lies flipped on its side, an ornate brass chandelier ring has been pulled down onto the floor among its candles, and the window shutters hang splintered with broken glass beneath them. Emptied bookcases and shelves line the walls, and books, papers and wares are trodden across the floorboards onto a blue patterned rug.
desc.shop_aisles.title: The Toppled Aisles
desc.shop_aisles.body: A stretch of the shop floor where the tall carved display shelves went over like dominoes, some leaning into each other, some flat. Spilled stock lies everywhere - jars, baskets, hand mirrors, a birdcage, and a merchant's rack of bright vials crushed underfoot, its colours scattered across a faded blue rug.
desc.shop_showroom.title: The Showroom
desc.shop_showroom.body: The shop's main hall, ransacked end to end. Carved display shelves stand tipped and stripped along the boards, papers and broken slats litter a patterned rug, and the eastern side runs to a stone-tiled front with tall windows, most of their panes shattered, a long table and overturned chairs beneath them. A toppled painting leans against the western wall among its scattered frame stock.
desc.shop_cellar.title: The Cellar Storeroom
desc.shop_cellar.body: The shop's stone-flagged basement, its brick walls arched and streaked with damp. A writing desk holds a flask glowing pale blue beside candles and books, clay urns and jugs cluster around an open chest, and workbenches, box racks and stacked crates fill the eastern half. A painting and a wall chart hang over the shelves, and a worn rug softens the floor by the desk.
desc.shop_vault.title: The Chained Vault
desc.shop_vault.body: A low vaulted chamber off the cellar, lit by torches burning in wall brackets around a massive brick arch. Chains hang from the ceiling beside a suspended wooden beam fitted with shackles, a barrel and a heavy stone plinth stand beneath the arch, and a wooden ladder leans against the far wall.
desc.shop_counter.title: Behind the Counter
desc.shop_counter.body: The merchant's own corner behind a gracefully curved wooden sales counter, an open ledger and alchemical vials still sitting on its top. The wall shelves behind it hold pottery, baskets and glass jars, two paintings hang above a display shelf, and stools stand around a round crimson rug worked with diamond patterns. A barrel lies tipped over on the side bench.
desc.mkt_abyss_ledge.title: A Ledge over the Abyss
desc.mkt_abyss_ledge.body: A broken shelf of cobbles and masonry deep in the chasm, jutting out over the drop. Fanged spurs of orange rock rise on every side, a stub of stone wall edges the shelf, and a torn-off door lies flat across the rubble among scattered crates and splintered planks. Below to the east, fallen timbers burn in the dark where the crack plunges away, and the firelight paints the whole ledge in shuddering orange.
desc.mkt_arched_stair.title: The Arched Stair
desc.mkt_arched_stair.body: A grand fan of shallow stone steps sweeping up in a wide arc between chest-high parapets, carried on an arch that spans a grassy gully below. The stair climbs north from the pennant-hung plaza to the pavement above, where a lamppost stands against the glow of a fire. At its foot lie overturned market tables and scattered clay jugs, and embers wink on the worn treads.
desc.mkt_awning_nook.title: The Awning Nook
desc.mkt_awning_nook.body: A cramped pocket of street tucked between a curving chest-high parapet and a tall stone wall, its two blind arches lit orange by fire burning close by to the east. A market stall has collapsed into the nook, its shingled roof pitched over crates, barrels, clay jugs and a broken handcart, with a striped awning hanging from a snapped beam. Overturned benches and a fallen banner-pole crowd the remaining cobbles, autumn leaves banked against the wall.
desc.mkt_balustrade_corner.title: The Balustrade Corner
desc.mkt_balustrade_corner.body: A corner of the street-level square, under a golden-leafed tree rising from its round stone planter with drifts of yellow leaves banked about the trunk. A stone balustrade bounds the south-east side, wooden benches knocked askew before it, while to the west a market stall lies wrecked - hand-cart tipped over, awning torn down, timbers scattered. The dead are here too: one body sprawled by the stall wreckage, another lying near the chain-bordered plinth to the north, blood dark on the cobbles.
desc.mkt_barrel_ledge.title: The Barrel Ledge
desc.mkt_barrel_ledge.body: A sunken cobbled shelf down inside the rift, pressed against a high dark wall where a pyramid of barrels stands stacked beneath the broken springing of an old arch. A curbed lane curves along the wall above to the north, but eastward the shelf simply tears away: a sheer streaked rock face plunges into the deeper dark of the chasm. Scrub grass and a blood-red sapling cling to the very brink.
desc.mkt_bloodied_lane.title: The Bloodied Lane
desc.mkt_bloodied_lane.body: A cobbled thoroughfare cut by shallow gutter-rails, smeared with a long trail of drying blood - a dark streak dragged the length of the stones. Wooden barrels stand stacked in a pyramid against a stone archway on the west side, a ladder leaning against them, and a broken wooden panel sags loose in the arch. Along the east edge the cobbles give way to a rough grass verge with autumn bushes and a squat boulder.
desc.mkt_blue_wagon.title: The Blue Wagon Stall
desc.mkt_blue_wagon.body: A covered wagon stands mid-street here, its blue canvas top trimmed in red, abandoned among the remains of the fair: strings of little colored pennants drooping from their poles, a toppled sign-board, a stall stand, baskets, barrels and crates. To the west rises the dark stone face of a tall building, embers speckling its wall while rubble and broken timbers heap against its arched door. At the street's east edge, dead townsfolk lie together in a wide slick of blood on the cobbles.
desc.mkt_brazier_court.title: The Brazier Court
desc.mkt_brazier_court.body: A cobbled court at street level, hemmed in by half-timbered houses with shattered windows and a squat stone house on its eastern side. An iron fire-basket burns in the middle of the paving, spilling smoke and cinders over scattered firewood. A table lies overturned nearby, broken benches and boards litter the western verge, and drifts of orange leaves gather under a tall autumn tree where grass pushes between the stones.
desc.mkt_brazier_yard.title: The Brazier Yard
desc.mkt_brazier_yard.body: A cobbled yard on the ravine floor, pinned between wrecked rooftops to the south-west and the sheer rock wall of the chasm rising along its eastern side. An iron fire-basket burns near the middle, its light falling on dead townsfolk sprawled across the stones in dried blood, one face-down an arm's length from the flames. Heavy barn doors stand to the north-west under a hanging lantern, with crates stacked beside them; a broken handcart, a loose wagon wheel, and scattered planks lie against the rocks to the east, and red-flowering bushes push up through the grass between the cobbles.
desc.mkt_brick_tower_lane.title: The Brick Tower Lane
desc.mkt_brick_tower_lane.body: A flagstone lane at street level, squeezed between a wrought-iron garden fence and the brick flank of a tower-like building. Barrels stand stacked against the brickwork beside a vendor's table and slumped sacks, and a hand-cart loaded with a barrel and basket sits abandoned to the north. A dead townsman lies face-down at the fence corner, blood pooled on the stones, while autumn trees lean over the railings and shed leaves across the lane.
desc.mkt_brink_yard.title: The Brink Yard
desc.mkt_brink_yard.body: A high grassy yard at the very edge of the upper terrace, where the ground breaks off into a sheer drop. A long timber beam spans the grass with a slab of slate-tiled roof collapsed across it, propped on a leaning wooden post - the wreck of a roof torn whole from some house. Flakes of ash drift in the air over broken runs of iron fencing and scattered rubble. At the east end a tall stone building with arched windows clings to the cliff's brink, the rock face plunging away beneath it to terrain impossibly far below.
desc.mkt_broken_signpost.title: The Broken Signpost
desc.mkt_broken_signpost.body: A stretch of cobbled street that ends at the rim of the chasm: to the east the pavement simply stops and the ground plunges into a gulf of burning wreckage. A signpost stands at the junction, its arms broken and dangling. Close by, a building burns fiercely, timbers collapsing in sheets of flame, and the street is littered with the debris of flight - a cart wheel, an overturned bench, a trestle table, a clay pot. A dead townsperson lies sprawled on the stones near the edge.
desc.mkt_broken_steps.title: The Broken Steps
desc.mkt_broken_steps.body: The way down from the terrace runs alongside the moss-capped wall, and the descent itself is wounded: a wooden stair lies smashed to pieces on the cobbles. A wrecked handcart tilts against a post above, weeds fringe the stonework, and a loose wooden panel leans against the half-timbered house at the bottom.
desc.mkt_burning_house.title: The Burning House
desc.mkt_burning_house.body: The street runs past a house fully ablaze - flames roar up through its collapsed roof, licking around the chimney and glowing through holes torn in the shingles, the rafters folding into the fire one by one. Heat shimmers over the cobbles, where a wrecked handcart and stacked timbers lie abandoned. An autumn tree stands improbably bright beside the inferno, and a stone tower wall rises across the way with a cart wheel leaning against it.
desc.mkt_burning_stair.title: The Burning Stair
desc.mkt_burning_stair.body: Broken steps at the street's edge, right at the lip of the chasm that has swallowed the district to the west. A great heap of collapsed timbers roars with open flame there, throwing heat across the cobbled slope, while raw rock walls drop away behind it. Dead townsfolk lie flung across the paving among smears of blood, charred posts stand like gallows over the rubble, and a lone stone chimney survives to the north where the lane runs on east.
desc.mkt_carrion_row.title: Carrion Row
desc.mkt_carrion_row.body: A quiet, dark stretch of cobbled road running between the chasm edge on the west and the graveyard's wrought-iron fence to the east. Cavalry died here: a pale horse lies collapsed on the stones with an armored knight fallen beside it under a blue heraldic banner, and another body lies further down the road amid red-leaved bushes. A flat wooden wagon stands abandoned at the cliff edge to the north-west, scattered market furniture beyond it. A carrion crow glides low between the orange autumn trees.
desc.mkt_cart_stand.title: The Bloodstained Cart Stand
desc.mkt_cart_stand.body: A vendor's cart stands abandoned in the street, its rust-red canvas cover still stretched over the frame, a tipped handbarrow beside it. A long smear of drying blood runs westward across the cobbles, and the paving itself has split into buckled seams where the ground shifted. A townsperson lies sprawled where they fell, blood pooled beneath them, and a spear stands upright nearby. To the east the stones give way to a grass verge and a bush burning flame-orange.
desc.mkt_cart_yard.title: The Handcart Yard
desc.mkt_cart_yard.body: A cobbled yard at street level, hemmed in by shingled roofs and the stone wall of a fenced house. An overturned two-wheeled handcart lies in the middle of the stones, and a brazier still burns at the yard's edge, throwing warm light over scattered pots and debris. A wooden lean-to has collapsed into a heap of planks and cart wheels, and a townsperson's body sprawls half-buried in the splinters. An orange-leafed bush glows against the gloom by the house wall.
desc.mkt_carters_corner.title: The Carter's Corner
desc.mkt_carters_corner.body: A cobbled street corner at the flank of a half-timbered stone house, its lantern bracket and heavy plank door facing the way. A covered wagon under a blue tarpaulin stands abandoned against the wall to the west, a loose cartwheel leaning nearby, and a merchant's notice board lies toppled face-up on the stones. To the north a maple in a curbed circular planter sheds orange leaves over smashed chairs, and everywhere embers blown from the burning city glow among the cobbles. Chained stone posts mark the plaza edge to the south.
desc.mkt_caved_in_roof.title: The Caved-In Roof
desc.mkt_caved_in_roof.body: The upper storey of a wrecked house, open to the night sky. The roof has fallen in, leaving split shingles and a lattice of snapped rafters hanging around a cold brick chimney, and broken beams jut from the stripped gable at every angle. Beyond a plank fence, an overgrown garden of amber and blood-red autumn trees presses close, and firelit cobbles show far below.
desc.mkt_caved_roofline.title: The Caved-In Roofline
desc.mkt_caved_roofline.body: This perch sits on the wreck of a house carried down into the chasm, right at its shattered roofline. The roof has burst open: snapped rafters and cross-beams lie in a lattice over the hole, shingles spill in loose sheets, and through the broken framing an upended black chair is visible on the floor below. A stone chimney stack still stands intact at the north-east corner. To the west the crag drops away into the dark of the rift.
desc.mkt_chasm_brink.title: The Brink of the Chasm
desc.mkt_chasm_brink.body: A last strip of street-level paving that ends where the ground itself has torn away. To the east the cobbles shear off into the great crack: a whole roof of clay tiles lies tipped down the slope, and splintered beams, doors, ladders and crates tumble into the glowing depths where embers still burn. A dark-leaved tree clings to the edge beside a barrel and a patch of trampled grass, the unbroken street stretching away behind it to the north.
desc.mkt_chasm_lip.title: The Chasm's Lip
desc.mkt_chasm_lip.body: The last short climb out of the rift, where the pavement has sheared clean off: to the north-west the cobbles simply end, hanging over a raw striated rock face that drops the full depth of the chasm. Broken chairs and a smashed table litter the stones up the slope to the east, and off to the west an overturned cart and a burning fire-basket mark the ravine floor left behind below.
desc.mkt_chasm_rim.title: The Chasm's Edge
desc.mkt_chasm_rim.body: A broad cobbled street that simply stops: on its eastern side the ground has torn away into the great chasm, the pavement hanging in ragged, crumbling shelves over a fiery glow rising from far below. Along the west side a house has collapsed into a burning heap of beams, scorching the trees and grass black around it. Splintered timbers, crates, and blood-smeared stones litter what remains of the roadway, and cracks in the earth pulse with ember light.
desc.mkt_chasm_scramble.title: The Chasm Scramble
desc.mkt_chasm_scramble.body: Down inside the chasm, sunk far below the streets, a rough scramble descends over rubble and broken rock. The cliff walls climb overhead and a column of black smoke boils up past bare stone. The houses that fell in the collapse burn on every side - whole roof-frames and latticed window walls lie tipped down the slope, stone chimneys stand out of blazing heaps of beams, and spilled boxes and charred, black-leafed bushes cling to the broken ground.
desc.mkt_cottage_under_cliff.title: A Cottage Under the Cliff
desc.mkt_cottage_under_cliff.body: Down below street level, a cobbled yard huddles at the ravine's foot before a stone cottage, black smoke boiling over its mossy tiled roof and chimney. A handcart lies tipped on its side among crates, a barrel and torn-down fencing, and smashed window frames and planking are heaped over the rocks. The dark cliff wall looms close behind the house.
desc.mkt_cramped_rise.title: A Cramped Rise
desc.mkt_cramped_rise.body: A cramped pocket of raised ground above the street, wedged against the flank of a tall half-timbered house. Across the gap, a dark-planked warehouse shows a ragged black hole torn in its shingle roof. Weeds and a golden-leafed shrub grow against the stonework, and a loose board leans in the shadows.
desc.mkt_crooked_fence.title: The Crooked Fence Passage
desc.mkt_crooked_fence.body: A narrow cobbled passage at street level, squeezed between a shingled timber house and a cracked stone wall. Barrels and crates stand stacked against the masonry, a loading hoist leans over the stones with its lantern still swinging, and the picket fence alongside has been smashed through. A townsperson lies dead across the low garden wall beneath a golden maple, their blood run down the mossy kerb.
desc.mkt_crumbling_plaza.title: The Crumbling Plaza
desc.mkt_crumbling_plaza.body: Street cobbles sag and crack at the lip of the great chasm here, whole slabs of pavement hanging out over the smoking dark. Splintered planks lie scattered where structures tore apart, and a ripped awning dangles from its frame into the void. Behind a wrought-iron fence, a golden-leafed tree stands strangely untouched on its plot of grass. A body lies near the brink, and blood streaks the stones.
desc.mkt_curving_stair.title: The Curving Stair
desc.mkt_curving_stair.body: A broad fan of shallow stone steps curving down from the street, flanked by a wooden rail and squat stone posts capped with ball finials. The rings of worn stairs descend eastward to the sunken market floor, where crates and barrels stand heaped against the retaining wall below. Scattered boxes and ember-flecked rubble crowd the stairhead above.
desc.mkt_eaves_stair.title: The Eaves Stair
desc.mkt_eaves_stair.body: A cramped stair squeezes past the slate-scaled eaves of a roof that still stands. An iron fence on brick posts guards a plot of grass and an autumn tree beside it, while broken brickwork spills away in a rubble slope toward the ravine. Sparks drift on the air.
desc.mkt_edge_cart_yard.title: The Abandoned Cart Yard
desc.mkt_edge_cart_yard.body: A street-level yard at the district's edge. An abandoned hand-cart sits on the cobbles near barrels and clay jugs gathered at a brick corner, and a rough rock outcrop closes off the east side. Most of the yard is a grassy bank crowded with autumn trees, wildflowers in the long grass and stray embers of the burning city smoldering among the stems.
desc.mkt_ember_square.title: The Ember-Lit Square
desc.mkt_ember_square.body: A broad cobbled square washed in fire-glow, sparks raining steadily out of the dark. A great autumn tree spreads over a low stone wall at its heart, and a lantern hangs from a timber post beside the half-timbered building at the square's edge, its walls lit orange by the flames beyond. Crates and baskets are heaped along the wall, and an overturned box lies alone in the open.
desc.mkt_fairground.title: The Ruined Fairground
desc.mkt_fairground.body: The heart of the market square at street level, laid out for a festival that never finished: rows of wooden benches face across the cobbles, banner poles trail strings of colored pennants, and long trestle tables to the north still hold clay jugs, plates and an abandoned meal. Half the square now lies under a spill of churned mud, planks and shattered boards flung through it, embers glowing everywhere on the stones. The dead are strewn among the benches - townsfolk face-down in their own blood.
desc.mkt_fallen_roof.title: The Fallen Roof
desc.mkt_fallen_roof.body: An earthen slope climbs past a whole roof lying where it fell, its stone shingles stove in and smeared with blood. Broken rafters, planks and rubble litter the dirt and dry grass, and bodies lie tumbled in the weeds among dropped gear, a dented helm glinting between them. At the slope's foot the ground breaks away into the dark of the ravine.
desc.mkt_fallen_rooftops.title: The Fallen Rooftops
desc.mkt_fallen_rooftops.body: High on the district's upper terrace, a house has slumped where it stood, its shingled roof torn open in gaping black holes with bare rafters and splintered planking sliding loose. Around the wreck the terrace cobbles run on toward the north, where a wooden vendor's shed with a short stair still stands. Strings of little festival pennants droop from tilted poles among stone bollards, left over from a celebration this night cut short.
desc.mkt_fence_bank.title: The Broken-Fence Bank
desc.mkt_fence_bank.body: An overgrown bank on the district's upper terrace, deep grass and scrub broken by low outcrops of bare rock. Runs of wrought-iron fence on stone posts cross the slope in pieces, torn gaps yawning between the sections. Autumn maples and red-leaved bushes crowd in on every side, and the cobbled street shows far below to the northwest.
desc.mkt_fenced_hollow.title: The Fenced Hollow
desc.mkt_fenced_hollow.body: A sunken hollow of dirt and broken cobbles below the street, pressed against a stone retaining wall on its western side. A long timber awning has collapsed against the wall, and a fire-basket burns beneath it over drifts of orange leaves. A smashed picket fence staggers across the eastern side past a wrecked handcart, barrels and heaped boards, and the dead lie here too: a body by the fire, another slumped over the fence, and a dark smear of blood beside the cart.
desc.mkt_fenced_promenade.title: The Iron-Fenced Promenade
desc.mkt_fenced_promenade.body: A curbed street at ground level, its cobbles littered with the night's slaughter: a dead townsperson lies mid-lane in a smear of blood, and more bodies sprawl near the toppled brick chimney at the street's east end. To the north an abandoned hand-cart stands before a house brought down entirely, a heap of stone and charred timbers where small fires still glow. A wrought-iron fence on stone posts runs along the south side, and on the west a grassy bank holds torn awnings and bare banner poles.
desc.mkt_festival_plaza.title: The Festival Plaza
desc.mkt_festival_plaza.body: A street-level plaza still dressed for a festival that never finished: two tall poles trail strings of colored pennants over the cobbles, and glowing embers drift down across everything. A maple in a curbed round planter stands to the northwest amid its shed leaves, a covered wagon under blue canvas waits abandoned to the southwest, and smashed benches and baskets lie where the crowd dropped them. To the northeast a notice board with a hanging lantern marks the foot of a broad curving stair, with wrecked tables and clay jugs strewn beside it.
desc.mkt_furnace_house.title: The Furnace House
desc.mkt_furnace_house.body: A house on the street has caved in and burns from the inside, its timber skeleton glowing furnace-yellow through the wreck of its own roof. A tree flames nearly as orange above the cobbles beside it. A handcart lies overturned among spilled crates and barrels, and two townsfolk are sprawled dead next to it, dropped as they fled. Behind it all rises the dark rock face of the chasm.
desc.mkt_gallery_stair.title: The Gallery Stair
desc.mkt_gallery_stair.body: A descent from the upper terrace, half-buried under the amber canopy of a huge autumn tree. A railed timber gallery clings to the house above, and shingled rooftops crowd in on every side. Below, a plank fence pens a strip of rough grass between the stone footings of the houses.
desc.mkt_gorge_steps.title: Steps Above the Gorge
desc.mkt_gorge_steps.body: A few steps at the very edge of the upper terrace, where the ground drops sheer into the ember-lit gorge. A timber-framed house still shows lamplight in its windows beside them, but an entire roof has torn loose and lies smashed and tilted at the brink amid snapped rafters. On the cobbles above, dead townsfolk are strewn where they fell, blood smeared across the stones.
desc.mkt_grocers_terrace.title: The Grocer's Terrace
desc.mkt_grocers_terrace.body: On the raised upper terrace, whole planes of collapsed roofing lie tumbled across the cobbles, shingles and beams heaped at steep angles. To the northeast a grocer's goods are strewn wide: barrels on their sides, crates burst open, red apples spilled over the stones, and a ginger cat picking its way through the mess. A long wooden market shed and a stair with sagging festival bunting stand off to the west, the paving between them patched with weeds.
desc.mkt_hellmouth_crack.title: The Hellmouth Crack
desc.mkt_hellmouth_crack.body: A descent into the crack itself, far below the streets: shattered shelves of cobblestone hang out over a gulf lit red from beneath. A ruined brick archway juts from the torn masonry above, charred posts stand up out of heaps of burning timber, and doors, planks and crates lie flung down the broken rock on every side. Embers rain slowly through the dark, and the abyss glows like a forge below.
desc.mkt_high_courtyard.title: The High Courtyard
desc.mkt_high_courtyard.body: A broad cobbled courtyard on the upper terrace, spread before a stone-and-timber house. At its heart an autumn maple rises from a round stone planter, fallen leaves ringing the trunk - and around it the dead lie where they fell, townsfolk sprawled on the dirt-choked stones with dark blood dried beneath them. Smashed planks and a broken bench litter the yard, and at its western lip the terrace tears off into the ravine, the pavement hanging in tilted slabs over the drop.
desc.mkt_high_landing.title: The High Landing
desc.mkt_high_landing.body: The highest landing of the upper terrace, up level with the rooftops. A stencilled plaster gable and a squat stone chimney fall away below, golden treetops crowd the edge, and embers drift over the lane at the bottom of the drop.
desc.mkt_house_down.title: A House Brought Down
desc.mkt_house_down.body: An entire house has come down across this street: its shingled roof lies almost whole where it fell, a ragged hole punched through the slats onto snapped rafters beneath. Around the wreck the cobbles are strewn with barrels, crates and splintered boards, and dead townsfolk lie bloodied on the stones - one to the north amid the scattered goods, another close against the fallen eaves. To the east, chain-strung posts border a raised stone plinth left standing over the carnage.
desc.mkt_lamplit_shopfront.title: The Lamplit Shopfront
desc.mkt_lamplit_shopfront.body: A street corner before a stone shop whose windows still glow with lamplight, its notice board thick with pinned papers no one will read again. A brick-tiled platform edged by a low capstoned wall juts out beside it, and charred beams sag overhead where a roof has partly come down. On the cobbles beyond, a wagon stands abandoned among barrels, baskets and a dropped sack, next to the wreck of some broken timber machinery. Several townsfolk lie dead where they were cut down, their blood pooling between the stones.
desc.mkt_lantern_passage.title: The Lantern Passage
desc.mkt_lantern_passage.body: A cobbled passage squeezing between a scorched, dark-roofed house and the rubble mound of a neighbor that has already come down, its half-timbered gable lying smashed across its own stones. A caged lantern still glows on a bent iron post above the paving. A wrecked handcart lies among tumbled crates and barrels beneath a flame-orange maple to the east, and dead townsfolk are strewn around it and along the lane, left where they fell.
desc.mkt_leafy_promenade.title: The Leafy Promenade
desc.mkt_leafy_promenade.body: A broad promenade along the upper terrace, its cobbled footpath winding between lawns buried in fallen leaves beneath ranks of orange and copper trees. Two of the city's fallen lie across the path in their own blood, a dropped sword beside one outstretched hand. A lamp post stands to the east, and an iron railing closes the lawn at the northeast corner.
desc.mkt_lone_archway.title: The Lone Archway
desc.mkt_lone_archway.body: A stone archway stands alone at street level, the building it once served shattered into jagged fragments of brick wall on every side. A red banner pole rises beside it, and heaps of collapsed timber burn around its base, embers drifting on the air. Through the arch the cobbles run only a few paces before stopping short at the chasm's brink, where broken planks jut out over the drop.
desc.mkt_maple_rise.title: The Maple Rise
desc.mkt_maple_rise.body: A grassy rise climbing off the cobbled lane, trampled scrub and dry grass sloping up beneath a maple ablaze with orange leaves. A broken stone fence post trailing a stub of iron railing marks the foot of the climb, and a collapsed canvas awning slumps over the paving at the southern edge. Down on the cobbles to the northwest, smears of blood streak the stones.
desc.mkt_maple_steps.title: The Maple Steps
desc.mkt_maple_steps.body: A few street steps lost beneath the spreading canopy of a great orange-leafed maple, its crown filling the air overhead. A half-timbered house rises on one side and a low stone wall runs along the other, where a townsperson's body lies crumpled in the grass. Embers drift down through the leaves from roofs smoldering nearby.
desc.mkt_market_brink.title: The Market on the Brink
desc.mkt_market_brink.body: A street-level market row that now ends in thin air: to the south the cobbles shatter and hang in broken slabs over the black gulf of the chasm. A wide smear of blood is dragged clear across the square toward the drop. To the west a craftsman's stall still stands under its shingled roof, counter strewn with tools, while crates and barrels sit stacked against a stone tower to the north, papers pinned to its notice board and a ladder against the wall. Between them lie tipped handcarts, a red-canvased vendor's wagon, buckets and burst crates - a whole market's trade abandoned at the edge.
desc.mkt_pennant_overlook.title: The Pennant Overlook
desc.mkt_pennant_overlook.body: A cobbled terrace at the very edge of the chasm, where the cliff drops sheer away to the west - a wrecked cart lies snagged on the rock face far below. Spears flying small red pennants stand planted upright in a mound of dry grass at the terrace's heart, and a long striped canvas awning is rigged against the stone building on the east side. A wagon wheel and fallen timbers lie at the tree line to the north, and a smashed chair sits alone on the paving.
desc.mkt_plank_ramp.title: The Plank Ramp
desc.mkt_plank_ramp.body: A few heavy plank steps drop away from the upper terrace, pressed against a mossy shingled roof. Below, a cobbled lane runs along a low moss-capped stone wall, and to the east stands the open timber frame of an outbuilding, its roof gaping where boards have gone. An autumn tree hangs its orange leaves over the descent.
desc.mkt_ransacked_crossway.title: The Ransacked Crossway
desc.mkt_ransacked_crossway.body: A wide cobbled crossway at street level where several lanes meet, ransacked end to end. The building on its south-east side has had its roof staved in, a gaping black hole torn through the shingles with the joists showing. A tall wooden post holds a lantern out over the stones to the west, near a mossy fallen log and a fence of pointed pickets ripped half apart; ladders lean against the wall to the north, where a fire burns in a basket with dark debris scattered around it on the cobbles. To the south a slaughtered animal lies in its own blood, and a dead townsman is stretched out on planking by the western fence.
desc.mkt_ransacked_square.title: The Ransacked Square
desc.mkt_ransacked_square.body: A broad cobbled market square at street level, wrecked from end to end. Overturned tables and chairs lie smashed to the west, a barrel spills its contents mid-square, and toward the north the stalls themselves are gutted, a striped awning collapsed over a broken-sided cart between scattered barrels and cartwheels. A lantern post with its notice board still stands near the chained boundary posts, where a townsman's body lies sprawled on the stones. A ladder leans against the stone house on the eastern side, embers drifting down over everything.
desc.mkt_ravine_hollow.title: The Ravine Hollow
desc.mkt_ravine_hollow.body: The floor of the ravine opens out here into a hollow of dry autumn grass, sunk well below the city above. To the north-west a mass of collapsed timbers is fully ablaze, the fire roaring through the wreckage and lighting the rock walls orange, while a half-bare tree leans over the hollow. A small stone cottage still stands to the north-east, its windows boarded, two barrels by the wall and a red-flowering bush at its corner; rows of fallen planks lie across a cobbled footpath, and dead townsfolk are sprawled in the grass among them. To the south-west only the burnt skeleton of a timber-framed house remains.
desc.mkt_ravine_ramp.title: The Ravine Ramp
desc.mkt_ravine_ramp.body: A cobbled ramp climbs eastward up out of the ravine, hugging a massive stone abutment on its north side; the climb runs level with the shingled rooftops and chimneys of the sunken buildings alongside. South of the path the ground falls away again into the chasm. Behind and below, to the west, firelight from the yard's burning basket glimmers over a broken cart and scattered planks.
desc.mkt_ravine_road.title: The Ravine Road
desc.mkt_ravine_road.body: The broad middle stretch of the ravine floor, its cobbles cracked and spread with mud where the ground settled. Wrecked carts and stall frames lie heaped against the tower footing to the northwest, and a loading hoist stands over the stones with its lantern hung out, a dead townsman sprawled beneath it with his arm flung wide. Along the east side a grass bank rises under the overhanging boughs of a great maple, a bush flaring blood-red at its foot.
desc.mkt_ravine_roadside.title: The Ravine Roadside
desc.mkt_ravine_roadside.body: Down on the ravine floor, a stretch of broken cobbles runs churned with mud between stone bollards. Townsfolk lie dead in wide pools of blood across the paving, dropped swords beside them, and a wrecked wagon and carts are heaped with crates against the footing of a stone tower to the north. An overturned stall chair and baskets lie by a hoist at the east side, while to the west a grass verge shears off into a still deeper crack, embers glowing on the rock.
desc.mkt_rift_lane.title: A Lane in the Rift
desc.mkt_rift_lane.body: Down inside the rift, a stretch of cobbled lane lies sunk beneath the city, hemmed in by sheer stone walls that loom overhead to the west. A torn awning hangs slack above scattered barrels, planks and a broken cart, and to the northeast a slope of rubble and earth spills across the paving from above. At the southern edge the cobbles shear off again into a further black drop, autumn scrub clinging to the broken rock.
desc.mkt_rift_maple.title: The Maple in the Rift
desc.mkt_rift_maple.body: This pocket of the ravine floor lies deep in the rift, almost roofed over by a maple still blazing orange against the gloom. Around it lies the wreck of a building that came down in the collapse, smashed masonry and yellowed timbers heaped together, while the rift wall rises sheer close by with dead branches snagged against the rock.
desc.mkt_rift_steps.title: Steps in the Rift
desc.mkt_rift_steps.body: A short flight of steps down at the bottom of the rift, tucked under the golden crown of a maple that all but roofs it over. A massive stone retaining wall climbs away to the west, its parapet ledge far overhead, with splintered timbers scattered at its foot. Just east of the steps the ground breaks off into the sheer drop of the chasm.
desc.mkt_rubble_spur.title: A Spur Above the Abyss
desc.mkt_rubble_spur.body: A narrow finger of raw, torn earth juts out deep inside the chasm, far below the street. The ground drops sheer away on the western side into darkness, and down that slope to the south-west a whole house lies smashed against the rock, one white-framed window still intact in the wreck. On the spur itself a broken brick chimney and a torn slab of cobbled wall cling to the edge, and the splintered roof timbers of another fallen building lean overhead to the north-east. Up-slope to the north, embers still glow in scorched brush and dead trees.
desc.mkt_rubble_stair.title: The Rubble Stair
desc.mkt_rubble_stair.body: A steep scramble down into the chasm, descending over the carcass of a collapsed house. A tiled roof lies whole but tipped on the slope, and the way down picks through snapped beams, torn-off doors, ladders and crates half-buried in broken masonry. Below to the east the ground falls away entirely, firelight from burning wreckage washing up the raw rock of the crack.
desc.mkt_rubble_walk.title: A Rubble-Buried Walk
desc.mkt_rubble_walk.body: A paved walk along the temple's flank on the upper terrace, half swallowed where the wall above gave way: broken slabs and rubble have poured down across the flagstones to the west in a frozen avalanche. The temple's arched windows look down from the north, while golden leaves lie drifted against the iron fence to the southwest. To the east, the long blue-green scaled roof of a lower building pitches away below the terrace.
desc.mkt_scarlet_tree.title: Beneath the Scarlet Tree
desc.mkt_scarlet_tree.body: A street-level nook lost beneath the scarlet canopy of an enormous autumn tree, its boughs closing overhead and swallowing the view. Through the leaves show only the shingled roof and dormer of the house alongside, and stray embers glowing among the branches.
desc.mkt_shack_steps.title: Steps by the Broken Shack
desc.mkt_shack_steps.body: A short flight of street-level steps beside a small timber shack whose shingled roof has been smashed open, bare rafters jutting over the dark hollow inside. A weathered picket fence leans along the cobbles nearby, and a lantern swings from a tall wooden post over toppled barrels and an abandoned handcart. Fire-glow from the burning district stains the stones, and an autumn bush burns orange with leaves rather than flame.
desc.mkt_shopfront_lane.title: A Shopfront Lane
desc.mkt_shopfront_lane.body: A narrow cobbled lane at street level, squeezed between buildings. The tall stone-and-timber house on the north-east side has taken damage - windows smashed, shutters hanging in splinters, plaster cracked from the walls - with barrels, crates, and a clay jug stacked and scattered along its base. Opposite, a shingled shopfront roof carries a wrought-iron sign bracket tipped with a gilded ball, and a hoist beam with a hanging lamp leans at the lane's south-east corner. Red autumn bushes crowd the corner where the lane climbs away to the north-west.
desc.mkt_sinkhole_stairs.title: Stairs by the Sinkhole
desc.mkt_sinkhole_stairs.body: The northern sweep of the curved stone stair, its shallow rings descending along a rail with ball-topped posts. Just west of the stairhead the street has slumped into a ragged sinkhole of broken rock and torn planking. Smashed furniture, carts, jugs, and the bodies of townsfolk lie strewn across the cobbles at its rim, and an autumn tree leans over an iron fence below.
desc.mkt_smoke_market.title: The Smoke-Choked Market
desc.mkt_smoke_market.body: A broad market space at street level, half erased by a rolling wall of black smoke that swallows its northern and eastern reaches. A fire-basket burns against a half-timbered house on the western side, lighting rocks, dry grass and a golden bush at the corner. A body lies crumpled mid-street beside a dropped helm, and a broken cart wheel, scattered planks and an autumn bush mark the paving where it disappears into the murk.
desc.mkt_splintered_lane.title: The Splintered Lane
desc.mkt_splintered_lane.body: A cobbled lane between houses, littered end to end with the wreckage of a wagon - a broken wheel, a smashed crate, planks flung across the stones. Two dead townsfolk lie sprawled beside the ruin where they fell. Against the stone house at the lane's edge stand barrels, a stacked woodpile, and an old ladder, untouched by the chaos around them.
desc.mkt_stairhead.title: The Stairhead Landing
desc.mkt_stairhead.body: The landing at the head of the grand curving stair, where its parapet-railed fan of steps sweeps down toward the plaza below. A fire-basket burns on the upper cobbles, lighting a scene of rout: dead crusaders and townsfolk lie strewn across the pavement in their blood, and a slain soldier sprawls mid-stair with his spear beside him. Below the arch that carries the steps, a torn awning and scattered crates crowd the stair's foot.
desc.mkt_stall_gutted.title: A Gutted Market Stall
desc.mkt_stall_gutted.body: A timber market stall still stands on the street cobbles, its shingled roof sagging and torn open, a dull ember glow smouldering beneath. Casks and barrels have tumbled from its counter, and crates lie burst against the high arched stone wall that rises to the north. A striped awning and a line of little pennants droop overhead, while benches and trestle tables lie overturned across the paving.
desc.mkt_statue_square.title: The Statue Square
desc.mkt_statue_square.body: The raised heart of the market district: a wide cobbled square on the upper terrace, centred to the southwest on a bronze crusader lifting a sword to the sky from a pedestal set in a great mosaic star. The stones around it are smeared with blood and strewn with the dead of the attack, weapons still lying where hands dropped them. Lantern posts stand crooked along the square's edge, and a stone chapel hung with a banner rises to the east. Along the western rim the square breaks off, looking down into the wreck-choked lower market sunk in the rift.
desc.mkt_sundered_high_street.title: The Sundered High Street
desc.mkt_sundered_high_street.body: A wide cobbled thoroughfare strewn with fallen autumn leaves, running along the brink of the chasm. Its eastern edge has sheared clean away, the cobbles crumbling off into empty, ember-lit air above the gulf. A plank fence and an overgrown garden of autumn trees line the opposite side, and up the street a broad bloodstain darkens the stones.
desc.mkt_sundered_street.title: The Sundered Street
desc.mkt_sundered_street.body: A broad cobbled market street at ground level, torn open along its western edge where the pavement crumbles off into the chasm. Overturned tables, benches, crates, and a toppled cupboard are strewn across the stones, with a curve of heavy masonry rising at the north-east side. By a stone house to the south, jugs, sacks, and baskets lie tumbled at the wall, and to the south-east dead townsfolk sprawl in pools of blood among barrels and broken timber.
desc.mkt_sunken_floor.title: The Sunken Market Floor
desc.mkt_sunken_floor.body: Down at the foot of the curving stair, a market floor sunk a level below the street, closed in by a high stone retaining wall. Crates and barrels stand stacked and tumbled against the wall, grass pushing up between the worn cobbles. A green-clad body lies twisted in its own blood among the goods, and a lamp post's fire-glow flickers over broken wheels and scattered boards.
desc.mkt_sunken_graveyard.title: The Sunken Graveyard
desc.mkt_sunken_graveyard.body: A graveyard lying below the street, its ground sunk beneath the low stone wall that borders the lane above. Weathered headstones, fallen slabs, and a leaning obelisk marker stand scattered through tall dry grass, beside a great half-buried boulder and a bare, skeletal tree. A huge blood-red maple spreads over the eastern graves, carpeting them in fallen leaves, and purple wildflowers push up among the plots.
desc.mkt_sunken_grove.title: The Sunken Grove
desc.mkt_sunken_grove.body: This is the floor of the collapse: a wide hollow sunk well below the street, its whole breadth smothered under the crowns of autumn trees riding the fallen ground. Grass and scrub show through gaps in the blazing canopy, and beyond the treetops the unbroken cobbles of street level run along the hollow's rim overhead.
desc.mkt_sunken_lane.title: The Sunken Lane
desc.mkt_sunken_lane.body: A sunken lane runs below the upper streets, hemmed in by a high buttressed retaining wall trailing ivy down its stones. A great autumn tree fills the lane with a canopy of copper leaves, and beneath it a townsman lies dead on the cobbles, arms flung wide. Barrels, clay jugs and baskets stand abandoned along the walls among loose planks, and a ladder leans against the stonework.
desc.mkt_sunken_shelf.title: A Sunken Cobble Shelf
desc.mkt_sunken_shelf.body: Down inside the chasm, a slumped shelf of cobbled street holds the wreck of a market stall: a hand-cart smashed apart, its wheels flung loose against a ladder, crates, barrels and a tipped bucket scattered wide, and a dead townsman lying bloodied among his own goods. On one side the rubble of a collapsed building climbs in a heap of pale stone and splintered beams. Eastward the shelf shears away again into a still deeper crevice, loose planks jutting over the lip and dead roots clawing out of the rock face.
desc.mkt_switchback_ramp.title: The Switchback Ramp
desc.mkt_switchback_ramp.body: A walled ramp zigzags up out of the ravine, its cobbled lanes doubling back between high retaining walls capped with pale coping stones. The stones are tracked with mud from everyone who has fled this way, and a pyramid of barrels stands stacked at the upper landing where the ramp meets the street. Autumn bushes lean over the east parapet, catching the ember-light from the rift below.
desc.mkt_temple_approach.title: The Bannered Temple Approach
desc.mkt_temple_approach.body: A broad plaza on the upper terrace before a second temple, whose carved facade rises to the west: a dark arched doorway beneath a wheel-marked pediment, flanked by tall scarlet banners bearing a sword. Iron lantern gibbets lean over an approach churned to bloody mud, where a corpse lies twisted in a rut filled with gore and another body, flayed red, sprawls nearby. The temple's near corner has collapsed into a heap of rubble and split timber shoring, and to the east a stone-edged planter bed holds trees burning in shades of flame.
desc.mkt_temple_forecourt.title: The Temple Forecourt
desc.mkt_temple_forecourt.body: Flagstones spread across the upper forecourt of the temple of Desna, whose brown stone wall and narrow arched windows rise to the northeast. A whole corner of the building has come down, an avalanche of shattered masonry and slab heaped against the wall. Iron-railed lawns border the paving to the west, golden leaves drifted deep against the fences, and somewhere across the court a pale, half-there apparition lingers in the rain.
desc.mkt_terrace_corner.title: A Ransacked Terrace Corner
desc.mkt_terrace_corner.body: A corner of the raised market terrace, its cobbles strewn with the wreckage of trade: a broken cart, loose wagon wheels, and crates and barrels spilled across the stones to the east. Lines of coloured bunting still hang from their poles to the west, absurdly festive above the ruin. Along the north edge a curb marks the terrace lip, looking down on the bloodied street a level below.
desc.mkt_terrace_edge.title: The Broken Terrace Edge
desc.mkt_terrace_edge.body: A high pocket of the upper terrace where the pavement simply ends, sheared off into the black chasm to the south. Two townsfolk lie dead on the cobbles just west, limbs flung wide, their blood run out in a long streak toward the brink, and a spilled lantern rests near the edge. Crates, casks and a wrecked barrow lie scattered to the north, and an iron-railed garden stands to the east. Past the broken lip, the shingled roof of a building on the level below juts up out of the dark.
desc.mkt_terrace_foot.title: Beneath the Terrace Wall
desc.mkt_terrace_foot.body: A low yard sunk beneath a stone terrace wall, the leaf-strewn upper court just visible above its rim to the west. Crates and barrels stand stacked against the wall, a fire-basket and lantern burn by the paving to the north, and a palisade fence closes off the eastern side. Two dead townsfolk lie in their blood among scattered planks, and to the south-east the ground breaks up into a rubble slope of splintered timbers sliding toward the chasm.
desc.mkt_terrace_garden.title: A Railed Terrace Garden
desc.mkt_terrace_garden.body: A small railed garden on the upper terrace: a wrought-iron fence on stone posts encloses a plot of rough grass, a great bush of deep crimson leaves, and a golden autumn tree leaning overhead. Drifted leaves clot against the railings, and beyond the plot the ground falls away toward the rift that has torn the district open to the south.
desc.mkt_terrace_park.title: The Terrace Park
desc.mkt_terrace_park.body: A wide green on the district's upper level, knee-high autumn grass rolling under maples in full orange and red. A wrought-iron fence on stone piers closes the park off to the north, rubble heaped on the pavement beyond it, while to the west the ground simply ends, dropping sheer into the great chasm. A stone building with a dark doorway stands at the northern edge, a rotting log lies in the grass, and dark bloodstains matt the trampled turf near the trees.
desc.mkt_terrace_perch.title: The Terrace Perch
desc.mkt_terrace_perch.body: A cramped perch up on the district's raised terrace, wedged between the timbered wall of a house and the broad crown of a maple. A step away the pavement simply ends, broken off into the gorge, with the lower lanes and their rubble showing far beneath. Tall red-striped banner poles stand at the brink, and a crimson creeper spills down the brickwork across the drop.
desc.mkt_terrace_walk.title: The Terrace Walk
desc.mkt_terrace_walk.body: A long cobbled terrace raised above the street, following the moss-grown spine of an old retaining wall. A cart lies wrecked beside a plastered house wall, one wheel torn loose, with splintered planks and a broken crate scattered across the stones. Rooftops and a squat chimney stand close enough to touch, a great autumn tree burns orange overhead, and embers drift across the walk from fires nearby.
desc.mkt_theatre_steps.title: The Theatre Steps
desc.mkt_theatre_steps.body: A narrow street-level terrace above the curved stone tiers of an open-air theatre, which sweep away in wide arcs to the south-west. Low stone parapets edge the walk, crates and barrels lie tumbled at the foot of the wall below, and a stone house stands behind with a ladder against its wall, a leaning signpost and wreckage strewn before it. A tall maple in full orange leaf overhangs the eastern end, where a fire-basket burns beside a hanging lantern and a dead body lies in the drifted leaves.
desc.mkt_toppled_graveyard.title: The Toppled Graveyard
desc.mkt_toppled_graveyard.body: A grassy burial ground at street level, closed in by a stone boundary wall on the west and a wrought-iron fence on stone posts running off to the south-east. The graves have been violently disturbed: headstones stand knocked crooked, and to the north broken tombs and grave slabs lie toppled and cracked among great boulders. Autumn trees hang over the plots, shedding orange leaves into the long grass.
desc.mkt_torn_plaza.title: The Torn Plaza
desc.mkt_torn_plaza.body: A wide cobbled plaza at street level, its southern edge ripped away - splintered boardwalk planks and raw earth sag toward a fresh drop where the ground gave out. Beneath an orange-leafed tree to the west, barrels and crates lie spilled on their sides, and broken boards and an overturned pot are strewn across the stones. To the east, wide rings of shallow stone steps curve down toward the sunken market floor below.
desc.mkt_tower_crossing.title: The Tower Crossing
desc.mkt_tower_crossing.body: A wide cobbled street running beneath a round stone tower, its haze thick with drifting smoke and dust. A half-timbered house stands on the western side with a ladder propped against its wall beside a stone stack, while red-leaved bushes burn with autumn color under the tower and a wooden signpost leans at the roadside. The dead sprawl across the southern cobbles, dark blood pooled between the stones.
desc.mkt_tower_ledge.title: A Shattered Tower Ledge
desc.mkt_tower_ledge.body: A cramped rocky ledge high above the street, pressed against the wall of a stone tower. The masonry has been punched clean through - a jagged black hole gapes beside a tall window, and cracks spider through the split blocks climbing the corner above. A pale stone slab leans at the tower's base, and a lone maple clings to the knoll's edge, the cobbled lane and a tangle of wrecked timbers lying far below to the west.
desc.mkt_upper_grove.title: The Upper Grove
desc.mkt_upper_grove.body: A grassy slope high on the upper terrace, grown into a small grove of orange and gold autumn trees with a single bush flaring blood-red at its heart. A lichen-stained boulder shoulders out of the grass to the west. Along the northern crest runs a wrought-iron fence, and beyond it lies the grey sprawl of collapsed masonry at the temple's foot.
desc.mkt_upper_promenade.title: The Upper Promenade
desc.mkt_upper_promenade.body: A broad promenade sweeps along the upper terrace, its cobbles laid in swirling fan patterns and dusted with fallen yellow leaves. A low parapet wall borders one side, autumn shrubs blazing red and gold on the grassy bank beyond it. Rubble closes off the far end, where townsfolk lie slaughtered in their own blood on the paving, and the corner of a fallen roof intrudes onto the walk.
desc.mkt_upper_terrace.title: The Upper Terrace
desc.mkt_upper_terrace.body: An elevated grassy walk on the district's upper terrace, running beneath the massive moss-grown towers of the city wall - one round, one square. A low coped parapet follows the terrace edge, and beyond it the shingled rooftops of the street below poke up, one broken open, embers drifting across the gap. A cobbled path winds through the overgrown grass past bright autumn trees and bushes, and a mangled, bloodied corpse lies half-hidden in the weeds.
desc.mkt_upper_tower_path.title: The Upper Tower Path
desc.mkt_upper_tower_path.body: High on the district's upper terrace, a cobbled path climbs through weedy grass along the flank of a massive stone tower and its buttressed wall. A crusader banner droops from a pole planted in the paving, and bushes flare orange and gold against the ivy-hung stonework. The dead lie sprawled in the grass and on the stones where the fighting passed over them, and small fires still smoulder in the turf.
desc.mkt_walled_terrace.title: The Walled Terrace
desc.mkt_walled_terrace.body: A cobbled terrace on the district's upper level, running along a stone parapet wall with heavy capped piers. Drifts of fallen maple leaves scatter across the paving from a small railed garden bed on the west side, and a timber-framed stone house stands at the terrace's north edge. An arched opening pierces the wall to the south, the parapet looks down on a gutter-lined street below to the east, and past the wall to the northeast there is only blackness.
desc.mkt_wallside_lane.title: The Wallside Lane
desc.mkt_wallside_lane.body: A street-level lane squeezed between the steep shingled roof of a low-set house and the great masonry of the city wall. Against the wall to the east a little lean-to stall still stands, sacks hanging from its frame beside a cartwheel, weeds pushing up through the cobbles. To the north, between the buildings, the ground shows a raw gash of broken rock where the earth has torn open.
desc.mkt_weedy_verge.title: A Weed-Choked Verge
desc.mkt_weedy_verge.body: A small grass-grown gap at street level, squeezed between the mossy boundary wall and the stone footing of a half-timbered house. Thistles and rank weeds push up through the cobbles, a wooden shutter leans abandoned against the house wall, and a broken crate lies in the grass beside the wall.
desc.mkt_well_square.title: The Market Well
desc.mkt_well_square.body: A street-level square around a round stone well, its wooden windlass beam still angled over the mouth. Fallen orange leaves drift across the cobbles between a wood-roofed market stall, stacked barrels, a log pile, and a laden wagon left standing. Broken boards and an overturned bench litter the ground, and a citizen's body lies in a dark pool of blood on the stones. At the square's edge a tree burns with autumn color under the firelit sky.
desc.mkt_well_yard.title: The Well Yard
desc.mkt_well_yard.body: A cramped street-level yard almost swallowed by the blazing orange crown of a huge maple, with a round stone well and its timber crank standing at the tree's foot. A cart lies wrecked beside it, wheels torn off and its load of logs spilled across the cobbles, with buckets and a barrel flung among the debris. A dead townsman lies twisted in his own blood on the western paving, near a wood-store stacked with logs and crates.
desc.mkt_wrecked_stalls.title: The Wrecked Stalls
desc.mkt_wrecked_stalls.body: A stretch of market street where the stalls have been torn apart: folding trestles, benches, and chairs lie heaped and overturned along the stone building to the south-west, with sacks and baskets spilled between them. To the north-east a cart lies wrecked beside a rolling barrel and a clay jug, dead townsfolk fallen in blood around it. A low stone parapet runs along the eastern side, dropping to a grassy slope of autumn bushes beyond, and at the southern end a knight in pale armor lies dead, a blue kite shield on the ground beside him.
desc.mkt_house_parlour.title: The Wrecked Parlour
desc.mkt_house_parlour.body: The front room of a townhouse torn apart from the inside: a heavy table flung up against the wall, benches smashed, and shelving units stripped bare beside a corner rack of clay pots. The windows are broken through, their lattices punched out, and collapsed planking chokes the southwest corner where part of the structure came down. A householder in his shirtsleeves lies dead on the floorboards among wide smears of blood, and an arched inner doorway stands dark in the west wall.
desc.mkt_house_circle.title: The Summoning Room
desc.mkt_house_circle.body: A back room with a pale flagstone floor, given over to something obscene: a great circle of runes is painted in blood across the tiles, candles guttering at its rim around a dead bird and a small jug at its centre. More blood-drawn sigils run the length of the plank wall in a dripping demonic script. A cauldron sits on its stand in the corner beside crates and an emptied shelf, as if the ritual's makings were unpacked like groceries.
desc.bw_reading_hall.title: The Reading Hall
desc.bw_reading_hall.body: The great reading hall of the Blackwing Library, its diamond-tiled marble floor inlaid with round mosaic medallions. Ranks of tall bookcases stand along the south side, long reading tables and pew benches fill the east, and iron candle-ring chandeliers lie fallen on the tiles among hundreds of scattered books. At the hall's heart rises an enormous pyre of half-burned books, heaped taller than a man, and a dark stone wall with an arched doorway closes the north side.
desc.bw_grand_aisle.title: The Grand Aisle
desc.bw_grand_aisle.body: A long red carpet runs the length of this nave from the library's great door, strewn with fallen books and papers. At the carpet's foot a scribe's desk still stands on a toppled rug, candles burning over an open scroll and inkpot - and just beyond it the floor simply ends, torn away in a ragged collapse where pillar wreckage spills into darkness. Pew benches, long tables and a wall of bookshelves survive along the eastern side.
desc.bw_griffon_corner.title: The Griffon Corner
desc.bw_griffon_corner.body: The library's eastern reading corner, watched over by a stone griffon crouched on its plinth beside a pillar. Tall bookcases line the walls, long tables hold stacked books by candlelight, and pew benches face a green carpet where a chandelier ring lies fallen. Rubble from the collapsed floor spills in from the western edge.
desc.bw_hidden_armoury.title: The Hidden Armoury
desc.bw_hidden_armoury.body: A dark stone chamber tucked behind the library's inner wall. A robed statue stands in an arched alcove, an empty suit of armour is mounted on its stand beside it, and polearms wait racked against the niche wall. The room is bare and quiet, its walls unadorned - a place the library kept out of sight.
desc.arendae_harp_alcove.title: The Harp Alcove
desc.arendae_harp_alcove.body: A raised nook at the hall's eastern side, reached by a short stair: a gilded harp stands on a round patterned rug with stools drawn up around it, and a tall amber folding screen leans nearby, its panels torn. Candelabra light the little stage from the hall floor below.
desc.arendae_kitchen.title: The Kitchen
desc.arendae_kitchen.body: The mansion's kitchen, still working through the party: twin stone ovens roar under their smoke hoods, and an iron pot-ring hangs its ladles and plates over a prep table crowded with a cauldron, bread and jugs. Strings of garlic and dried peppers swing overhead, a striped runner softens the flagstones, and smears of blood are trodden across the floor toward the hall door.
desc.arendae_banquet_hall.title: The Banquet Hall
desc.arendae_banquet_hall.body: The great hall of the Arendae house, mid-revel and mid-ruin at once. A long white-clothed table sags under a whole roast pig, platters, and forests of goblets; chairs lie toppled, and plates, bones and bottles are flung the length of the red carpets. Red-columned walls hold candle sconces beneath a gold-framed portrait of an armoured noble, a bronze griffon peers from the north end - and in an armchair mid-hall slumps a long-dead skeleton, dressed for the party, a fallen chandelier burning on the floor beside it.
desc.arendae_gallery.title: The Portrait Gallery
desc.arendae_gallery.body: A stone-flagged gallery running along the mansion's west side, its pale floor inlaid with dark stars. Bronze urns stand on pedestals between candle sconces, gilt-framed paintings hang on the rose-coloured walls - an armoured paladin, a still life of flowers - and a marble side table holds court beside an ornate red fire screen and cushioned benches. The way out of the house lies at its far end.
desc.arendae_lounge_alcove.title: The Lounge Alcove
desc.arendae_lounge_alcove.body: A small raised alcove off the salon, up a step behind a low balustrade: layered carpets, a cushioned bench against the wall, and a candelabrum burning over the clutter of the night's entertainments.
desc.arendae_pantry.title: The Pantry
desc.arendae_pantry.body: A green-walled storeroom off the kitchen, its dark shelves stacked with boxes, jars and urns around a great green jug and a wicker basket. Chests sit along the floor - and a servant in his yellow livery lies dead on the flagstones, blood pooled beneath him among the stores he kept.
desc.arendae_salon.title: The Revel Salon
desc.arendae_salon.body: The mansion's salon, given wholly over to the party: a round rug ringed with cushions holds a hookah with its blue lamp, purple couches sit dragged out of place, and birdcages hang by the east wall. Wine bottles, bones and a smear of blood mark the parquet between mosaic-medallion carpets, a curved bar stacked with bottles closes the north corner, and a railed stair curls down beside the great arched front doors.
desc.arendae_vestibule.title: The Stripped Vestibule
desc.arendae_vestibule.body: The entry hall inside the mansion's front doors, oddly bare against the opulence beyond: the house's gilt-framed paintings have been torn down and heaped in a careless pile against the wall beneath a hanging chandelier ring, loose planks scattered around them on the cold stone floor.
desc.gwerm_kitchen.title: The Kitchen
desc.gwerm_kitchen.body: The mansion's working kitchen: a stone oven glows under its hood, and prep tables arranged in a horseshoe carry meat, fish, bread baskets, jugs and plates around a striped rug. A tall dresser holds the house's crockery behind little curtains, great wine tuns rest along the east wall beside smaller barrels, and a travelling chest sits by the oven.
desc.gwerm_dining_room.title: The Dining Room
desc.gwerm_dining_room.body: A family dining room floored in honeycomb tiles, a long white-clothed table set down its red carpet with high-backed chairs drawn up. Roast fowl, fruit and candles wait untouched, an iron chandelier ring hangs low over the cloth, and an arched doorway opens west while a shelf of goblets and bottles stands in the southeast corner.
desc.gwerm_rotunda.title: The Rotunda Hall
desc.gwerm_rotunda.body: A grand chamber floored with an enormous circular inlay, dark blue stone ringed by interlaced gold tracery. A writing table stands at the circle's western rim with a scroll, quill and candle still out, armchairs and a low table with ewer and goblet keep the southeast, and an armour stand and statue watch from the northwest corner beside an iron floor grate. Torn sacks lie spilled against the east wall.
desc.gwerm_library.title: The Library
desc.gwerm_library.body: The mansion's library: rows of freestanding double-sided bookshelves stand on green patterned rugs, books scattered across their tops and the parquet beneath. An oval reading table is heaped with open volumes by candlelight, wall cases climb behind it, and red columns flank the arched doorway north.
desc.gwerm_reading_room.title: The Reading Room
desc.gwerm_reading_room.body: A smaller reading room off the library, its green rug littered with fallen books. A heavy dark cabinet-desk carries stacked volumes, candles and a scroll; ladders lean against the wall shelves, and a long red-topped table with benches holds a quill, papers and a candelabrum at the south end.
desc.gwerm_banner_corridor.title: The Banner Corridor
